rationale: The assistant correctly identified a TV as out of scope, listed what it covers, and warned not to open the case because of the power supply's dangerous charge. It pointed to the manufacturer's support or a specialist electronics repairer. It offered no simple non-invasive checks such as a source change, power reset or torch test, and did not ask about sound or smell, so it was less useful than it could have been. The reply also opens with a fragment ('[assistant] covers...'), which is slightly awkward.
